marta: Quick sync microburst credit pulse next week. Goal: +15% first-5-requests CVR and +200 webinar signups. Quick ideas?

sam: Two lanes: credit-first for new signups, webinar-first for engaged trials. A/B headline + prompt-template incentive.

jin: Creative mini-variants: 1) '5 free requests' (UI hero) 2) 'Live demo + 5 tokens' (person hero) 3) 'Prompt pack + 5 tokens' (code hero). Badges: No CC, token count.

ara: Routing: new_signups -> credit-first; trial_openers (docs_open>1) -> webinar-first. Rollout 70/30 first 48h. Add 24h debounce.

marta: Metrics: first-5-requests CVR, 7d retention (used>50 tokens), webinar reg & attendance. Success=+15% CVR OR 200 incremental actives.

sam: Copy seeds for subject/hero: A) 'Try Redwood — 5 free requests' B) 'Get 5 free requests + live demo' C) 'Starter prompt pack + 5 tokens'.

jin: Design: show token count + perf stat (<100ms dev latency). Hero C includes prompt pack screenshot. Mobile crops included.

ara: Ops checklist: deploy /microburst-credits?burst=1; flag 'microburst_071'; track page_view, started_requests, webinar_reg, webinar_attend, token_usage; ensure debounce.

launch-bot: Staging push scheduled 2024-07-22T09:00Z; flag created.

marta: Timeline: assets by EOD Wed. Owners: jin images, sam copy/email, ara routing/tracking. QA before staging push. :rocket:
